selected_leaf.objective: Test whether the final authoritative effect can be represented only by an immutable Git object handle plus repository incarnation identity, eliminating a second name-addressed publication step.
selected_leaf.scope: 240 synthetic strategy-scenarios plus inspection of currently exposed GitHub connector schemas already available in this invocation. No repository deletion/recreation was performed.

strategies.atomic_repository_id_plus_object_sha_rea: Desired primitive: final dereference is keyed by immutable repository incarnation identity plus immutable object SHA and never falls back to owner/repo name.
strategies.repository_id_read_with_name_fallback: Try identity-fenced read first, then fall back to owner/repo name if the original incarnation is unavailable.
strategies.identity_precheck_then_name_object_read: Resolve/check repository identity, then perform a separate owner/repo-name-addressed object read.
strategies.name_only_object_read: Handle carries old repository identity but consumer dereferences the immutable object through owner/repo name only.

selected_leaf.safety_rule: Unsafe iff a replacement repository can satisfy a stale handle as though it were the original authority. Rate-limit traces fail closed to later-invocation checkpoint; response-loss retry repeats the same identity rule and never authorizes a name fallback.

repository_id_read_with_name_fallback.unsafe_mechanism: same-name replacement with copied object is accepted through fallback

identity_precheck_then_name_object_read.unsafe_mechanism: TOCTOU recreation after successful identity check but before name-addressed object read

name_only_object_read.unsafe_mechanism: replacement can satisfy stale immutable handle whenever the copied object is present at dereference

connector_schema_observation.observation: The currently exposed fetch_blob primitive is addressed by repository_full_name plus blob_sha, not repository numeric/node identity. The exposed repository metadata tools accept repository_id, and the generic read surface advertises Git-data GET support, but this invocation did not spend another repository-read batch to verify a numeric-ID Git-blob URL.
connector_schema_observation.inference: An immutable object handle is not yet a proven final authority on the inspected path. The remaining candidate is a direct numeric-repository-ID plus immutable-object read with no name fallback; its availability is a narrow connector-route child, not a semantic completion claim.
connector_schema_observation.scope_guard: Do not infer actual GitHub repository-ID non-reuse, object retention after deletion, or support for /repositories/{id}/git/blobs/{sha} from the schema description alone. Those remain unverified.

new_narrowing: Making the Git object immutable removes content mutation but not repository-incarnation rebinding. Safety requires the final consumer dereference itself to be identity-fenced. A separate identity precheck is detection-only across the check/read gap, and any owner/repo fallback reintroduces the same-name recreation vulnerability. Under the bounded model, only an atomic repository-incarnation-ID plus object-SHA dereference has 0/60 unsafe traces; that primitive remains unverified on the current Chat connector route.
